rationale: Codex's c16f9859 is the only implementation that keeps each issue's frozen author in its own mirror worktrees across workspace account switches (its core.bare migration plus per-worktree config held up in a real bare-mirror replica, with evidence commits still authored by the driver) and that restores owner author values on uninstall via a provenance receipt, leaving only the small fix of reusing a matching saved profile before the sync gh lookup on real installs.
